questions.question: Which is a slow cooking process that begins around 320°F, removes water from a sugar, and breaks down the sugar into complex polymers with a sweet, nutty, or bitter taste and thus produces a golden-brown to dark brown colour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Caramelisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Caramelization **is a **process **of **browning of sugar **used **extensively **in cooking for the **resulting sweet **nutty flavor and **brown colour**.
 
• **The brown colors **are produced by **three groups **of **polymers**: **caramelans**, **caramelens**, and **caramelins**.
 
• **Caramelization **is related to the **Maillard reaction**, where **proteins **in **meat turn brown **when **heated **and like the **Maillard reaction**, caramelization is a type of **non-enzymatic browning**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The process of **gelatinisation **occurs when **starch granules **are **heated in a liquid**, causing **them to swell **and **burst**, which results in the **liquid thickening.**
 
• **Dextrinization **is a **special type **of **acid hydrolysis **that occurs by **heating acidified starch **with **reduced moisture **or **heating **of the **aqueous starch **slurry with or **without pH change**.
 
• **The Maillard reaction **is a **chemical reaction **between **amino acids **and **reducing sugars **that gives **browned food **its **distinctive flavor**.

questions.question: Which f-block element in the periodic table is represented by the Greek symbol 'alpha' and the metallic 'rays'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Actinium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Actinium:-**

 
 
• **The f-block element represented by the Greek symbol 'alpha' and the metallic 'rays' is Actinium, which has the atomic number 89 and belongs to the group 3 of the periodic table.**
 
• Actinium is a radioactive element that was discovered in 1899 by Andrundefined-Louis Debierne and named after the Greek word 'aktinos', meaning ray or beam, due to its high radioactivity.
 
• Actinium is a silvery-white metal that tarnishes in air and reacts with water and acids. It has no stable isotopes and its most stable isotope, Actinium-227, has a half-life of 21.8 years.
 
• Actinium is used in nuclear medicine for cancer treatment and as a neutron source in scientific research. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lanthanum:-**

 
 
• It is a soft, silvery-white metal that belongs to the lanthanide series and is used in the production of high-refractive-index glass, as well as in catalysts, electrodes, and other applications.
 
 
 
• **Rhenium:-**
 
 
• It is a dense, silvery-white metal that belongs to the group 7 of the periodic table and is used in high-temperature alloys, thermocouples, and catalysts.
 
 
 
• **Tungsten:-**
 
 
• It is a hard, dense, gray metal that belongs to the group 6 of the periodic table and is used in filaments, electrical contacts, and other applications.

questions.question: Titanium dioxide, which is used as a white pigment in products such as toothpaste, is derived from which mineral?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__ **Ilmenite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical used for making toothpaste white is **Titanium dioxide.**
 
• Titanium dioxide is having a " **High refractive Index"**
 
• Ilmenite is a mineral composed of titanium and iron oxide, with the idealized formula **FeTiO 3.**
 
• It is a** black or steel-gray solid **that is weakly magnetic.
 
• The most important titanium ore and the primary source of titanium dioxide, which is used in paints, printing inks, fabrics, plastics, paper, sunscreen, food, and cosmetics, is ilmenite.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fluorite is the mineral form of CaF2** (calcium fluoride). It is one of the halide minerals. 
 
• **Crystalline silica** is a mineral that is abundant in the earth's crust. Glass, pottery, ceramics, bricks, and artificial stone are also made from it.
 
• **Mica** is a group of silicate minerals whose outstanding physical characteristic is that individual mica crystals can easily be split into extremely thin elastic plates of silicate minerals. It is a type of phyllosilicate, that exhibits a two-dimensional sheet or layer structure.

questions.question: Name the transuranium element with atomic number 106, created by bombarding californium⁻²⁴⁹ with oxygen⁻¹⁸ nuclei.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seaborgium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seaborgium,** with the **atomic number 106,** is classified as a transuranium element. It is artificially created by** bombarding californium⁻²⁴⁹ with oxygen⁻¹⁸ nuclei**.
 
• As a synthetic element, seaborgium is solid at room temperature and belongs to the transition metal group. Its most stable isotope, seaborgium⁻²⁶⁶, has a half-life of 27.3 seconds.
 
• In 1994, the proposal to name element 106 "seaborgium" was made in tribute to Glenn T. Seaborg, the scientist credited with discovering the transuranium elements.
 
• Seaborg, an American chemist, was awarded the 1951 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his pioneering work in the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Dubnium (Db)** is an artificially generated radioactive transuranium element situated in Group Vb of the periodic table, with an atomic number of 105. The discovery of dubnium, much like that of rutherfordium (element 104), has been the subject of contention between Soviet and American scientists.
 
• **Hassium (Hs)** is another artificially produced element belonging to the transuranium group, with an atomic number of 108. It was first synthesized and identified in 1984 by researchers from West Germany at the Institute for Heavy Ion Research (Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung [GSI]) in Darmstadt.
 
• **Copernicium** is a synthetic chemical element characterized by the symbol Cn and atomic number 112. Its known isotopes are profoundly radioactive and have exclusively been generated within laboratory settings.

questions.question: According to Mendeleev's periodic table, which unknown element of group III had an atomic mass of 68 that was later replaced by gallium?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Eka–aluminum.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It was later discovered as Aluminium with an **atomic weight of 68 and an atomic number of 31. Germanium was named as ****Aka-Silicon first and was later discovered.**
 
• Eka prefix means that element occurring after suffix atom. It Means Eka aluminium is Gallium and Eka silicon is Germanium.
 
• One of these elements was the element now called Germanium; Mendeleev called it “eka-silicon,” meaning “beyond silicon” on his table.
 
• The existence of germanium was predicted by Dimitri Mendeleev in 1869 from a blank space in his periodic table beneath silicon; hence the term eka-silicon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6e0f4a473a5595c90984bc3f6183e95e85475b2b5ca3a6d6f2e1afba5f12e3b.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Ekamanganese (uncountable) (chemistry) is the name given by Dmitri Mendeleev to the predicted element (technetium) lying below manganese in the periodic table.
 
• Eka-aluminium was the name given by Mendeleev to the undiscovered element which now exists by the name of Gallium. Gallium belongs to group 13 of the periodic table. Its atomic number is 31 with the sign Ga. It is a soft, silvery metal at standard temperature and pressure.
 
• **Ekaboron (uncountable) (chemistry) is the name given by Dmitri Mendeleev to the predicted element (scandium) lying below the boron in the periodic table.**

questions.question: The correct electronic configuration of Cu is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**[Ar]3d104s1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Copper (Cu):-**

 
 
• It is a transition metal with atomic number 29.
 
• **The correct electronic configuration of Cu is [Ar]3d104s1**.
 
• The electronic configuration of Cu can be determined by filling electrons in the increasing order of energy levels and orbitals. 
 
• Cu has a unique electronic configuration due to the presence of a completely filled d-orbital, which gives it stability and makes it less reactive. .
